description: Code cleanup pass: remove unused imports, dead code, and consolidate redundant patterns
steps: STEP 1 - Audit and remove unused imports from App.jsx. Currently imports: Plus, Trash2, X, ChevronDown, FileText, Network, FolderOpen, Palette, Check, ZoomIn, ZoomOut, Focus, Download, Upload, Undo2, Redo2, Layers, Link2, ExternalLink, Sparkles, PanelLeftClose, PanelLeft, Copy, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, RefreshCw, LayoutList, MonitorSpeaker, MoreVertical, ImageIcon, ChevronUp, Scissors, ClipboardPaste, Lock, Shield, Eye, EyeOff, GitBranch, Map, Timer, CheckSquare, ListTodo from lucide-react. Check each is actually used in the JSX. Remove any that are not used (e.g., 'Shield' appears in imports but check if it's referenced in the component).

STEP 2 - Remove unused state variables if any exist. Check: 'connecting' state updates setConnectHoverNodeId but verify all state setters have corresponding readers. Check if 'viewMode' related mobile states like 'mobileSheet' have dead code paths.

STEP 3 - Consolidate the two auto-save useEffect blocks (around lines 800-830). Both do setProjects + debounced localStorage.setItem. Merge them into a single useEffect that handles both workspaces/activeTab/nextId changes AND storedPassword changes with one debounced write.

STEP 4 - Remove the redundant 'getTaskStats' function and inline the computation since it only computes nodes.length, which is trivially available. Replace 'const stats = getTaskStats()' with a direct useMemo or inline 'nodes.length' where stats.total is used (only one place in the sidebar).

STEP 5 - Clean up the multiple similar useEffect blocks for keyboard shortcuts. There are 7+ separate useEffect hooks for keyboard shortcuts (Escape, M, T, S, N, Arrow keys, Ctrl+Z/C/X/V, Alt+Shift+X). Consolidate into a single keyboard event handler useEffect that dispatches based on key combinations. This reduces event listener registration overhead and makes the code more maintainable.
STEP 6 - Remove the 'computed unused' import 'Shield' from lucide-react if confirmed unused. Also check 'Circle' import in TaskPanel.jsx is used (it is, in the linked card chip).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build completes with no errors or warnings
No behavioral changes to any feature
Keyboard shortcut handlers are consolidated into fewer useEffect blocks
Auto-save logic is consolidated into one useEffect
verification: Run npm run build and confirm no errors
Verify the bundle size is equal to or smaller than before
findings: All imports in App.jsx and TaskPanel.jsx are actively used (including Shield). No unused state variables found. Auto-save was already consolidated in FEAT-002. getTaskStats was already removed in FEAT-002; the remaining trivial useMemo for stats was removed and nodes.length inlined directly. Keyboard shortcuts consolidated from 7 separate useEffects down to 2 (core Ctrl combos + single-key shortcuts). Added refs for focusedNodeId, focusedGroupId, and selectedNodeIds to avoid frequent event listener re-registration. Build passes at 311.80KB (down from 312.59KB).
